'''Frisal''' was a terrestrial<ref name="Planets" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Frisal" /> located in the [[Frisal system/Legends|Frisal system]], a part of the [[Atrisian Commonwealth/Legends|Atrisian Commonwealth]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="Southern Core" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[loirbnigg]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of eight-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creatures.<ref name="Planets" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained Frisal as a preserve world for affluent Imperial families.<ref name="CSWE Frisal" /> Members of the Imperial [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] also vacationed on the planet, and the aristocrats<ref name="CSWE Loirbnigg">{{CSWECite|II|259|loirbnigg}}</ref> [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]]<ref name="CSWE Frisal" /> and trained loirbniggs for use as mounts.<ref name="CSWE Loirbnigg" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frisal was first mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]'', which was authored by [[John Terra]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Planets3">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Frisal [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet Frisal, in grid square J-12.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
